description: XRF kernels of braggsim.fluorescence.kernels for one sample: detected photons per incident photon on lam_pm (pm) then the four Mo components Kα1, Kα2, Kβ1,3, Kβ2 (every k, rayleigh, compton has len(lam_pm) + 4 entries); pin_eff = detector.pin_efficiency at the line energy, at the midpoints of the Rayleigh / Compton continuum intervals of mca_counts, and for the Mo scatter lines (pin_eff_mo_lines). scale_per_source_unit = fluorescence._scale(scan.DEFAULT); air_in_mg_cm2 = incident air path of _t_in
